prep_sequence_logical.sequence: Fill holes → Fill open grain → Sand filled → Full sand → Clean dust → Caulk baseboard → Caulk casing

door_opening_counting_rule.rule: Door openings counted per SIDE: interior door = 2 sides, exterior door = 1 interior side

open_grain_quantification.evidence: Based on measurable opening counts, not arbitrary estimates
